methods.label: Solve and select the integer endpoint
methods.explanation: Expanding gives \(2x-6\geq5x+3\). Rearranging gives \(-3x\geq9\). Dividing both sides by -3 gives \(x\leq-3\), so the greatest integer solution is -3.
methods.levelReason: Expansion, linear inequality transformations, and selecting an included integer endpoint require only Grade 7 reasoning.
